description: Ask the person you're helping to let you act for their MakerRadar account. Returns a short code and a link: show them both, they sign in and approve you on MakerRadar. Then call connect_account_finish with deviceCode until it returns your token. No sign-in needed to start.

client.description: Your name as the person should see it (e.g. Claude Code). Optional.

name: connect_account

deviceCode.description: Your secret: pass it to connect_account_finish.

interval.description: Seconds to wait between finish calls.

verificationUriComplete.description: Or this link, which carries the code.

title: Connect to a person's account
